content: {"episode_id":"ep-05002","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial for CPT 93229, for which prior authorization is missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate-control management. We request reconsideration based on this documented clinical indication."}
